group_canopy_coverage: area(group intersect union of predictions) / area(group)
linked_predictions: site-clipped predictions with positive area overlap with group; include predictions ignored by primary individual-tree scorer
linked_union_iou: area(group intersect linked prediction union) / area(group union linked prediction union)
limitations: Complete group-area coverage can result from one merged polygon or many fragmented polygons; it cannot validate tree number. Adjacent crowns affect linked-union IoU; overlapping groups can double-count area.
held_out_gate: same supervisor-approved reference freeze and completed prediction run record as primary scoring
